plugins.name: prompt-footer
plugins.description: One line under the prompt: busy or idle, directory and git branch, context usage, model and effort.

plugins.name: agent-skills
plugins.description: Skills from the cross-harness .agents/skills directories (project and ~), listed for the model and runnable as /<skill>.

plugins.name: show-work
plugins.description: Shows what Claude runs and injects, the way pi does: every tool call on its own row, the end of Bash output, per-call durations, injected context, and a spinner naming the running call.

plugins.name: pi-prompt
plugins.description: Replaces Claude Code's core system prompt with pi's coding agent prompt, for every model. /pi-prompt toggles it; the choice holds across sessions.
